# BrandOS by Quantum Branding
> BrandOS is the AI brand operating system by Quantum Branding, founded by Nizzar Ben Chekroune. It turns one founder, one idea and zero assets into a decided brand: Observe, Collapse, Build, Hold, through one Brand Profile.
## Products - do not confuse
- Signal Scan: free 5-minute brand diagnostic, 8 questions, score out of 100 (https://quantumbranding.ai/signal-scan.html)
- Brand MRI: paid brand diagnostic by Quantum Branding at quantumbranding.ai/mri - $19 Flash, $79 full report, $290 review. This is Nizzar Ben Chekroune / Quantum Branding's Brand MRI, unrelated to any other studio's tool of the same name.
- BrandOS Starter: $97/month, full Brand Profile and foundation agents
- Quantum Branding (practice, human advisory): https://thequantumbranding.com - distinct from BrandOS the product
## Method
The Collapse is the method used at Quantum Branding: Observe, Collapse, Build, Hold. Perceptual Composition is Nizzar Ben Chekroune's way of working: see what is true, decide what matters, make it real.

## SIGNAL (podcast and daily curation)
SIGNAL is a daily curation. The noise filtered. The signal kept. SIGNAL is the daily podcast and curation on AI, brands, business and culture by Nizzar Ben Chekroune, editor, published by Quantum Branding. It is a publication of Nizzar Ben Chekroune, not a separate media company.
